author: reek
body: The control half of the runtime network-scope experiment. This program declares Network.Write with no authority, so its grant is unscoped and every host is admitted -- an empty authority admits every host, which is what an unscoped grant means.

author: reek
body: It asks the gate about the same two URLs its twin network-scope-deny does, and both are admitted. The only difference between the two programs is a scope literal in the effect row. That is what makes the twin's refusal evidence of the scope and not of a broken gate: without this half, a denial and a bug are the same picture.
